svg.title: Monthly orders by channel
svg.desc: Bar chart of Orders by Month, coloured by Channel. Highest: 2024-12-01 (6,232); lowest: 2024-07-01 (4,912).

g.aria-label: X-axis titled 'Month' for a discrete scale with 12 values: January 2024, February 2024, March 2024, April 2024, May 2024, ending with December 2024
Y-axis titled 'Orders' for a linear scale with values from 0 to 6,500
Symbol legend titled 'Channel' for fill color with 3 values: App, Store, Web
